quotes.speaker: Kyrie Irving
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving on the Mavericks' team approach against the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: we wanted to focus on our game plan tonight which was pushing the pace
quotes.quote: It was a good match up tonight. We obviously knew they were short-handed, but OKC is well-conditioned to win ball games, especially down the stretch. You still got Shai out there. It was definitely a different look, but we wanted to focus on our game plan tonight which was pushing the pace and making sure we were physical. We brought the fight to them and I felt like we did that all four quarters.

quotes.speaker: Kyrie Irving
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving on managing his workload and team success
quotes.excerpt: I try to get out of my own way and lead with worrying about team success
quotes.quote: It feels amazing. I'm not taking any moment for granted. Obviously with the minute restriction, mentally it could get a little selfish at times, but I try to get out of my own way and lead with worrying about team success and doing all the little things. Just in terms of my burst and feeling good out there, that's an A-plus, but everything else will fall into place as we continue to progress in the season.

quotes.speaker: Kyrie Irving
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving on Jason Kidd's coaching and leadership
quotes.excerpt: he let us in every statistical category basically and it's not many 18 and 19 year olds
quotes.quote: It started last year, me coaching from the sideline or me being on the sideline more often and just texting him after games. He let us in every statistical category basically and it's not many 18 and 19 year olds that are doing that. So he already has the special talent. He already has the competitive drive to go out there and compete against the best and now it's my job to go out there and make sure that I'm fulfilling my role as a leader alongside him.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley on the challenges of mentoring young players
quotes.excerpt: How do you balance I need to teach these young guys I've been through it

text_blocks.speaker: Charles Barkley
text_blocks.text: Kyrie, number one, when you've had a great career and you've been a great player, you come in as the teenager. You have a great career, then you become the old geezer, and you kind of have to balance I need to teach these young guys I've been through it. Because you know a lot of times it's like when we're talking to our kids, they think we were born old. They don't realize like, no, there's nothing you're going to experience on a basketball court I haven't been a young great player. I've won the world championship. I've been an All-Star multiple, multiple times. How do you balance that like, guys, I've been through the wars, just listen to me?

quotes.speaker: Kyrie Irving
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving on the Mavericks' young roster development
quotes.excerpt: the luxury that I have on this team is we got a lot of young guys
quotes.quote: For me, I'm still figuring it out as we come into the season. I think most important thing is we had some time to gel in the summertime. We came in, we put in a lot of work in training camp. The luxury that I have on this team, especially being an older guy and veteran, is we got a lot of young guys that are trying to still prove themselves. We got Zachary Risacher who's the number one pick in Atlanta. I don't want to say they gave up on him, but they let him go and now he's on our team doing all the little things. You got Walter Clayton Jr. and of course, Cooper is going to do what he does, but these young guys have a very strong competitive nature.

quotes.speaker: Kyrie Irving
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving on maintaining mental and physical health
quotes.excerpt: I've been out for 19 months and it was tough every single day just rehabbing
quotes.quote: Even at this age, just making sure I'm staying confident in my game and try not to get to a place where I'm overthinking basketball. I've been out for 19 months and it was tough every single day just rehabbing, making sure that I kept my mental strong, making sure that physically I was ready to go. I know you guys are seeing all the unfortunate injuries in the league right now as we start off the season, so just wanted to make sure my body was ready for the combat and the competition level.
